what: Cross-check of the FwDET edge depth against the 홍수위험지도 depth classes (SEG_CODE), national rivers, 100 y
method: 60 random points inside the flood extent of each basin file; depth = median GLO-30 elevation of the flood edge within 500 m minus ground at the point (worker/climaterisk_worker/floodmap_depth.py); median depth per class
reading: Edge depths rise with the class code in every basin (monotonic with both code versions). Pooled class medians: N330-N332 and N334 fall inside the published bands in code order; N333 (1.82 m) sits just below its 2-5 m band, consistent with a conservative-low surface DEM. This supports the edge depth and the inferred order N330 = shallowest ... N334 = deepest; the order is not officially confirmed. About 20 % of inside points get 0 m (mostly the shallowest class).
licence: Only summary statistics are stored; no polygon, clip or raster derived from the maps is written.
code_version: window-clipped extent (commit 7b9f689); per-basin class medians are from the first run (full-outline extent), pooled values from the current code
